title: UAE Logistics Brief
lede: Iran says four more tankers were hit in Hormuz on Thursday, and Hormuz transits are down to a handful a day. The UAE answer is land: DP World has now moved over one million containers from the east coast by road and rail, while Saudi air links stay cut, with Etihad cargo off Riyadh and Dammam until 19 November.

gauges.note: Against a pre-crisis baseline of 85 a day (IMF PortWatch via Straits.live, 12 Nov)

stories.headline: Iran says four more tankers hit in Hormuz; transits down to a handful
body: Iran's military said four oil tankers were hit by explosions in the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday after ignoring warnings. Reuters could not verify the claim. On Wednesday a tanker was hit by a projectile about 14 nautical miles northwest of Ras Al Khaimah, causing an engine-room fire; UKMTO said all crew were evacuated.

At least 10 ships were hit in the first 10 days of November, after 37 attacks in October, according to the Washington Institute. IMF PortWatch counted just 3 transits on 8 November, against 85 a day before the crisis. CENTCOM says it is enforcing an "ironclad naval blockade" on Iran.
stories.soWhat: New: the attacks are now off Ras Al Khaimah, inside UAE waters' approaches, and traffic is close to zero. Sea war-risk charges stay; there is no case for cuts this month.
stories.source: Reuters via Yahoo News; Straits.live; Gulf News

stories.headline: DP World moves over 1 million TEU around Hormuz by road and rail
body: DP World moved more than one million TEU from UAE east-coast ports to Jebel Ali and domestic markets between early March and end October. Its land corridors carry about 3,500 TEU a day, using more than 3,000 trucks, 700 of them its own. Jebel Ali Rail Terminal is open and Etihad Rail now links Jebel Ali to the national network.

DP World has brought forward its new Fujairah terminals to 18–24 months, from 24–30. Al Rugaylat will handle about 2.5 million TEU a year. Jeddah South Container Terminal now has 4 million TEU of capacity, and Sohar and Duqm are also in use.
stories.soWhat: The east-coast-to-Jebel Ali land bridge is now the main UAE import route. Our trucking and rail capacity on it is a product we can sell, not just a cost.

stories.headline: Etihad cargo off Riyadh and Dammam until 19 November
body: Etihad has cancelled all passenger and cargo flights from Abu Dhabi to Riyadh and Dammam through Thursday 19 November. Abu Dhabi–Jeddah is back at up to four flights a day. Emirates has Riyadh and Dammam cancelled until at least 13 November and flies Jeddah twice a day.
flydubai has suspended Riyadh with no return date. Riyadh's King Khalid airport has only partly resumed after an October suspension that followed attacks on it.
stories.soWhat: New: Etihad's cargo halt adds to SkyCargo's suspension to 27 November. Both main UAE carriers are now off Riyadh, so road freight stays the only reliable option.

stories.headline: UAE trade near Dh3 trillion in nine months, up 10%
body: Sheikh Mohammed said UAE foreign trade reached nearly Dh3 trillion ($817 billion) in the first nine months of 2026, up 10% on the year. Exports to the top 10 partners rose 31%. The UAE has signed 38 CEPA deals, with 18 in force.
stories.soWhat: Trade is growing through the war, rerouted rather than lost. CEPA markets with deals in force are where to push export express and freight.

stories.headline: noon's 11.11 sale ends today, with 15-minute delivery on noon Minutes
body: noon's 11.11 sale runs from 5 to 13 November with up to 90% off. It promises 15-minute delivery deals on noon Minutes and 90-minute delivery on Supermall.
stories.soWhat: Returns and late orders follow the sale next week. Watch domestic volumes and reverse-logistics demand from marketplace sellers.

competitors.name: DHL Express
competitors.headline: Signs export-training deal with UAE Ministry of Foreign Trade
body: The Ministry of Foreign Trade signed an MoU with DHL Express for an "Export Readiness" initiative that aims to train more than 10,000 UAE companies. DHL's GoTrade programme plugs into the ministry's Ready2Trade SME scheme. Training covers export procedures, compliance, documents, trade finance, e-commerce and CEPA opportunities.
competitors.soWhat: DHL gets a government-backed route to 10,000 SME exporters. We need our own SME export offer and a seat with the ministry, or DHL owns this pipeline.

competitors.name: DP World
competitors.headline: Over 3,000 trucks and rail on the east-coast bypass
body: DP World runs a trucking network of more than 3,000 vehicles, 700 owned, moving about 3,500 TEU a day from Fujairah and Khor Fakkan to Jebel Ali. Jafza occupancy is above 90%, and a $250 million Jeddah Logistics Park is due in Q1 2027.
competitors.soWhat: DP World now sells end-to-end land logistics, not just port handling. Expect it in freight tenders; price our east-coast trucking against it.

competitors.name: Emirates SkyCargo
competitors.headline: Launches 'AI Tech' product for servers and chips
body: Emirates SkyCargo launched AI Tech for server racks, semiconductors, GPUs and capital equipment, with priority loading, dedicated handling and monitoring from its Dubai command centre. It moved more than 700 tonnes of AI infrastructure in July alone and will have 23 freighters by March 2027.
competitors.soWhat: High-value tech is becoming a premium vertical. Freight should pitch data-centre projects with secure handling before carriers sell direct.

competitors.name: Aramex (baseline)
competitors.headline: Record Q3: revenue AED1.98bn, up 24%
body: New baseline, replacing Q2. Q3 revenue was a record AED1.98 billion, up 24%, led by Freight Forwarding; all four segments grew. Net profit was AED47.8 million against AED5.2 million a year ago, and EBIT rose 46% to AED94 million. Gross margin fell to 21% from 23.2% as the mix shifted to freight. Nine-month revenue was AED5.41 billion, up 16%.
competitors.soWhat: Freight is driving growth but at thinner margins. Pricing should protect gross margin on forwarding as war-time rates eventually ease.

opportunities.title: Sell the land bridge
opportunities.text: About 3,500 TEU a day already moves from the east coast to Jebel Ali by road and rail. Package our trucking, bonded transit and rail as a door-to-door Hormuz bypass.

opportunities.title: Riyadh by road
opportunities.text: Etihad cargo is off Riyadh and Dammam to 19 November and SkyCargo to 27 November. Customers need a priced UAE–Riyadh road service now.

opportunities.title: SME exporters in CEPA markets
opportunities.text: Trade is up 10% and 18 CEPAs are in force. Build an export express bundle for SMEs before DHL's training programme locks them in.

opportunities.title: AI and data-centre freight
opportunities.text: SkyCargo moved 700+ tonnes of AI kit in July. Target project cargo for UAE data-centre builds with secure handling.

opportunities.title: Post-sale returns
opportunities.text: noon's 11.11 sale ends today. Offer marketplace sellers reverse-logistics capacity for the returns wave.

watchouts.title: Attacks near RAK
watchouts.text: A tanker was hit 14 nautical miles off Ras Al Khaimah. The risk zone is now close to UAE ports.

watchouts.title: DP World as a logistics rival
watchouts.text: It owns the ports, 700 trucks and rail links. It can bundle and undercut us on land legs.

watchouts.title: Thinner freight margins
watchouts.text: Our gross margin fell to 21% from 23.2% as freight grew. Rate falls after a ceasefire would squeeze it further.

watchouts.title: Conflicting oil readings
watchouts.text: One tracker had Brent near $96 while Gulf News reported $91.22. Do not move fuel surcharges on a single reading.

moves.title: Publish an east-coast to Jebel Ali trucking rate card
moves.text: Quote Fujairah and Khor Fakkan to Dubai and Abu Dhabi by truck, with transit times, for key importers this week.

moves.title: Extend the Riyadh road offer to 27 November
moves.text: Etihad and Emirates are both off Riyadh. Keep the road rate live at least until SkyCargo returns.

moves.title: Hold sea war-risk surcharges
moves.text: Transits are down to single digits and attacks have reached RAK. Keep charges and brief key accounts.

moves.title: Approach the Ministry of Foreign Trade
moves.text: Ask to join the Export Readiness programme as a logistics partner alongside DHL.

moves.title: Set a margin floor on forwarding deals
moves.text: Freight is our growth engine but cuts gross margin. Add a minimum margin check to freight quotes above a set size.

moves.title: Launch a secure tech-cargo offer
moves.text: Package high-value handling for servers and chips and pitch UAE data-centre contractors.
